record_scope_reconstruction: Serbian freight-terminal campaign is a set of participating road facilities with differing directions/timing, not identical full-border closure. January30 AMSS roster: Batrovci, Sid, Bogojevo, BackaPalanka, Bezdan, Ljuba, Sot, Horgos, Kelebija, BackiBreg, VrskaCuka, Gradina, Strezimirovci, Ribarci, Mokranje, SrpskaCrnja, Kaludjerovo, Djerdap, Presevo, ProhorPcinjski, Gostun, Jabuka, Spiljani; Nestin and Vatin exit-only. Separate Montenegro-frontier phase began after Montenegrin protesters ceased.
